title: AI career links and document checks
items: TuklasBot can link to matching courses, jobs, scholarships, and account pages that are available to your role.
Document scans now show extracted details, profile and requirement checks, and verified next steps when supported by the document.
Unclear or missing document details are left unconfirmed instead of being guessed.

title: Scholarship application review update
items: TESDA reviewers can check each scholarship's requirements and open the applicant's uploaded documents from the mobile application.
Applications are accepted only when the applicant message and uploaded documents are complete and available.
Declining an application asks for a reason, while accepting it no longer asks for an unnecessary reason.
The website and Android release use the same scholarship review rules.

title: Role-focused mobile navigation and course tools
items: Admin, TESDA, and Career Seeker accounts now have five role-specific bottom navigation destinations, with grouped tools in readable menus and Document Scanner available from a floating action button.
Admin and TESDA staff can add, edit, and delete courses from training center cards in the mobile app, with center access checks and linked-record protections.
Wide desktop dashboard and course catalog layouts use more of the available screen width.
Android build version advanced to 1.0.18 build 19.

title: Clearer document scanner photo capture
items: Photos taken for a resume or certificate now appear in a highlighted Ready to scan list, and the scanner brings that list into view.
A confirmation explains when the photo is ready and how to start scanning it; capture errors are shown clearly.
Camera photos are resized to reduce memory and upload problems on lower-spec phones.

title: Mobile photo sharing fix
items: Camera photos are resized for reliable sending and shown as a preview before you tap Send.
Android camera results can be recovered after an app restart and stay tied to the conversation that opened the camera.
Received message photos now appear inline, and tapping a photo lets the recipient save it.

title: Clearer course requests and mobile navigation
items: Course request buttons now say Request course; the selected training center and location stay visible with each course.
Mobile grouped navigation switches content in place instead of opening an extra screen.
Mobile controls, dropdowns, dialogs, and tabs use the Tuklas theme and responsive sizing.
TESDA schedules now show assigned trainers and can generate the exact course duration in editable dates, with weekend and non-working-day options.

title: Updated Tuklas logo across web and mobile
items: The new Tuklas logo appears across the website, sign-in and registration pages, and workspace navigation.
Updated browser, home-screen, Android, and iOS app icons.
The mobile app headers and onboarding screen now use the same logo.

title: Easier scanner access and career matches
items: Career Seekers and Admin can open Document Scanner from the main mobile navigation after the Career Seeker completes the required skills assessment.
Follow numbered steps to choose or capture a document, add an optional career goal, review consent, scan, and check suggested next steps.
PESO job matches show the role and documented-skill coverage first; expand a match to read its supporting skills, evidence, and learning resources.
Mobile text uses an explicit no-underline default to prevent inherited text decoration from affecting the interface.

title: Mobile layout update
items: Pagination controls adapt to narrow screens across the mobile workspaces and catalogs.

title: Mobile navigation and career guidance update
items: Career Seekers can browse published career paths, and Admin can create, edit, publish, archive, and remove career paths from mobile.
Dashboard shortcuts now open the intended PESO AI and career-path screens; TESDA dashboard actions show only training-role functions.
Reduced motion is enabled by default on mobile and can be changed in account settings.
Mobile document scanning supports camera capture and PDF, DOCX, and image files; messages support file attachments.
Mobile authentication and job-form requests use the same normalized account and validation rules as the website.

title: Flexible training request decisions
items: TESDA staff and PESO administrators can accept a course request before an intake date is available, then assign a future intake with available places later.
The website and mobile app can clear an expired or full intake while accepting a request, and keep declining requests available independently.

title: Career guidance and easier updates
items: Complete a skills assessment and save interests to receive initial career, job, and training suggestions, including paths for people without a resume or NC certificate.
Browse the full patch history from the website or mobile app, newest updates first.
Career Seekers can apply for verified job openings in the mobile app and follow their application status and PESO feedback.
PESO administrators can review job applications in the mobile app, update their status, and provide a reason when an applicant is not selected.

title: Workspace and account improvements
items: Admin user management can create accounts with secure initial passwords, and mobile account forms show password strength.
Messages update in real time across the website and mobile app while connected, with automatic catch-up if the connection drops.
Use grouped role navigation, clearly labeled mobile tabs, and next-step workflows.
Career Seekers and PESO administrators can use PESO AI and document scanning; training staff see role-specific tools.
Scholarship listings show eligibility, application requirements, provider assessments, and source links.
Browse DOLE PhilJobNet vacancies and TESDA training catalog information.
Workspace forms preserve entered details when validation needs correction.
The mobile app retries saved sign-in when the server becomes reachable or the app resumes, and reports clearer connection errors.
Retry scan history and keep selected files available after a failed scan.

title: Live message updates
items: Messages sync between the website and mobile app in real time while connected, then catch up automatically after a connection drop.

title: Clearer catalog and workflow records
items: Training, job, scholarship, and activity records are visible for workflow practice, with their descriptions identifying fictional records where applicable.

title: More reliable document scanning
items: Scanner uploads use the same API address and connection handling as other mobile requests.
Retry scan history, and keep selected files available after an upload or scan fails.
Android and iOS builds normalize the website URL before configuring the API address.

title: More complete training and scholarship details
items: Scholarship listings show eligibility, application requirements, provider assessments, and source links.
Browse job vacancies from DOLE PhilJobNet and updated TESDA catalog records.
Career Seekers and PESO staff can use career guidance and document scanning; training staff see the tools for their role.

title: Role-based next steps
items: Dashboards show role-specific next actions on the website and mobile app.
Use the Career Seeker, TESDA, and document-scanner labels consistently across the app.

title: Clearer loading and form recovery
items: Mobile navigation responds immediately when changing sections, and the website shows a loading state while new pages open.
Web management forms keep entered details when validation needs correction.
The app waits for slow server responses and distinguishes connection timeouts from secure connection errors.

title: Mobile connection recovery
items: The app waits longer for a slow server before reporting a connection problem.
Retry a saved sign-in when the server becomes reachable again or the app resumes.
See clearer messages for slow responses and secure connection problems.
Browse jobs, scholarships, training centers, and training sessions; apply for training and track requests and assessment records.

title: Training and opportunity workflows on mobile
items: Browse jobs, scholarships, training centers, and training sessions.
Apply for training and track applications and assessment records.
Staff can manage centers, trainers, schedules, and opportunities according to their role.
See release notes after installing an app update.
